reserveReview.rationale: At Ethereum block 26196563 (2026-10-15T07:57:11Z), totalAssets=35318046503247 raw USDC, totalSupply=34404401040963463160177117 raw shares, idle USDC=2033369465 raw. The sole adapter reports 35323102016447 raw USDC across all three enumerated lender markets: cbBTC 25094669198111, wstETH 9932099790042, WETH 296333028294; all three positions have zero borrow shares and zero posted collateral. Real assets including idle total 35325135385912; the 7088882665 raw USDC difference from totalAssets is undistributed positive interest under maxRate, not an extra reserve or missing exposure. The measured idle/deployed partition is 0.00575731%/99.99424269% of same-block totalAssets and is published as separate idle and deployed slices, not 100% deployed cash or borrower-collateral holdings; borrower-collateral allocation weights are a separate look-through book. Lending allocations are approximately 71.04% cbBTC, 28.12% wstETH and 0.84% WETH of real assets, not vault holdings of those collateral tokens. Family pass (block 26196563, 2026-10-15T07:57:11Z): after the config-version-2 measured split, idle USDC is classified under the underlying key at 0.005757310118% and non-idle lender claims under the vault :deployed key at 99.994242689881%, using the producer's held/totalAssets denominator.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Pinned idle USDC and complete sole-adapter market census; measured idle/deployed split published under separate underlying and vault :deployed keys
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: Direct idle and deployed categories and current borrower-collateral identities are established. Legal segregation, insolvency priority and future allocations remain unresolved; parent USDC reserves are not vault-level financial assurance.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: Immediate lender claims are held by the vault, its adapter and Morpho contracts. The material cbBTC borrower-collateral leg is backed by BTC held by Coinbase, alongside onchain wstETH/WETH collateral and USDC issuer exposure; aggregate custody is mixed. The lender allocations are not direct cbBTC holdings or custody percentages. This establishes heterogeneous custody, not legal segregation, bankruptcy remoteness, signer independence or insolvency priority. Lending deployment is intentional strategy reuse; it does not establish custodians' contractual rights to repledge collateral, which remain unknown.
